name: Playwright
description: Browser automation and web testing via local Chrome or Edge.
setupHint: Requires Chrome installed locally (or change --browser chrome to msedge).

name: Chrome DevTools
description: Inspect DOM, console logs, network requests, and performance in Chrome.
setupHint: Requires Chrome installed locally.

name: Context7
description: Fetch up-to-date library documentation and code examples.
setupHint: Works without an API key; optional CONTEXT7_API_KEY increases rate limits.

name: Filesystem
description: Read, write, and search files in allowed local directories.
setupHint: Replace C:/path/to/workspace in Args with the local folder path you want to expose.

name: GitHub
description: Manage GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and code search.
setupHint: Bind a Credential containing your GitHub Personal Access Token (injected as GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN).

name: Notion
description: Search, read, and update Notion pages and databases.
setupHint: Remote Notion MCP server. Bind an OAuth or Bearer token Credential if prompted.

name: Linear
description: Manage Linear issues, projects, and team workflows.
setupHint: Remote Linear MCP server. Bind an OAuth or API token Credential if required.

name: Atlassian
description: Access Jira issues and Confluence pages via Atlassian remote MCP.
setupHint: Remote Atlassian MCP server. Bind an OAuth or API token Credential if required.

name: Asana
description: Manage Asana tasks, projects, and team workspaces.
setupHint: Remote Asana MCP server. Bind an OAuth or Bearer token Credential if required.

name: Stripe
description: Interact with Stripe payments, customers, and billing APIs.
setupHint: Remote Stripe MCP server. Bind a Stripe API token Credential.

name: Neon
description: Manage Neon serverless Postgres branches, databases, and SQL queries.
setupHint: Remote Neon MCP server. Bind a Neon API key / OAuth Credential.

name: Fetch
description: Fetch web pages and convert HTML content into clean Markdown.
setupHint: Requires uv/uvx installed on the host machine.

name: Brave Search
description: Web and local search powered by the Brave Search API.
setupHint: Bind a Credential containing your Brave Search API key (injected as BRAVE_API_KEY).

name: Tavily Search
description: AI-optimized web search and content extraction via Tavily.
setupHint: Bind a Credential containing your Tavily API key (injected as TAVILY_API_KEY).

name: Memory
description: Persistent knowledge-graph memory stored locally across sessions.
setupHint: Optionally set MEMORY_FILE_PATH in Env to customize the storage file.

name: Sequential Thinking
description: Structured step-by-step reasoning and problem decomposition tool.
setupHint: Ready to use out of the box with no extra configuration.

name: Time
description: Get current time and perform timezone conversions.
setupHint: Ready to use out of the box with no extra configuration.

name: PostgreSQL
description: Inspect schemas and run read-only SQL queries on PostgreSQL.
setupHint: Replace the PostgreSQL connection string in Args with your database URL.

name: SQLite
description: Query and inspect local SQLite database files.
setupHint: Replace C:/path/to/database.db in Args with your local .db/.sqlite file path.

name: Kubernetes
description: Manage Kubernetes clusters, pods, deployments, services, and logs.
setupHint: Uses your local kubeconfig (~/.kube/config) to connect to Kubernetes clusters.

name: Podman
description: Manage Podman containers, images, pods, and volumes.
setupHint: Requires Podman installed and running on the host machine.

name: Google Drive
description: Search, list, and read files from Google Drive.
setupHint: Requires Google Cloud OAuth credentials configured locally for Google Drive API.

name: Gmail
description: Search, read, draft, and send emails in Gmail with auto-auth.
setupHint: Requires Google Cloud OAuth credentials (gcp-oauth.keys.json) for Gmail API.

name: Outlook
description: Read, search, and manage Outlook emails and calendar via Microsoft Graph.
setupHint: Requires Microsoft Azure App credentials configured for Outlook / Graph API.

name: Feishu
description: Read and manage Feishu/Lark documents, tasks, and workspace data.
setupHint: Fill in FEISHU_APP_ID, FEISHU_APP_SECRET, FEISHU_AUTH_TYPE (tenant/user), and FEISHU_USER_KEY in Env.

name: DingTalk
description: Interact with DingTalk contacts, calendars, tasks, and robot messages.
setupHint: Fill in DINGTALK_Client_ID and DINGTALK_Client_Secret in Env.

name: Grafana
description: Query Grafana dashboards, datasources (Prometheus/Loki), alerts, and incidents.
setupHint: Requires uv/uvx installed locally and Grafana 9.0+. Set GRAFANA_URL in Env and bind a Credential for GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.

name: Jupyter
description: Interact with Jupyter notebooks, execute cells, and inspect outputs.
setupHint: Requires uv/uvx installed locally. Set JUPYTER_URL in Env and bind a Credential for JUPYTER_TOKEN.

name: Excel & CSV
description: Read, write, format, and analyze Excel and CSV files with 37 tools.
setupHint: Ready to use out of the box with no extra configuration.

name: Desktop Commander
description: Execute long-running terminal commands, manage processes, and edit files with search/replace.
setupHint: Ready to use out of the box with no extra configuration.

name: Vercel
description: Manage Vercel projects, deployments, logs, and documentation via remote MCP.
setupHint: Remote Vercel MCP server. Bind an OAuth or Bearer token Credential if prompted.

name: MongoDB
description: Query and manage MongoDB databases and MongoDB Atlas clusters.
setupHint: Update MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING in Env (or use MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_ID and MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_SECRET for Atlas). Remove --readOnly from Args if write access is needed.

name: GitLab
description: Interact with GitLab repositories, issues, merge requests, and CI/CD pipelines.
setupHint: Defaults to gitlab.com; replace with your self-managed GitLab URL if applicable, and bind an OAuth or Bearer token Credential.
